key_insight: HorizON jointly learns DFT redox potentials and cycle-dependent specific-capacity trajectories from full organic battery-stack representations and usage conditions.
engineering_relevance: Predicting capacity across cycling could support organic battery-stack design and process optimization beyond single-cycle performance.
method: Uses a multi-fidelity, multi-horizon Deep Operator Network.
Learns DFT redox potentials and capacity trajectories within one model.
Represents the complete battery stack and usage conditions to capture component interactions.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes training on complete battery-stack representations and usage conditions but reports no dataset sizes, evaluation metrics, or quantitative results.
watch_item: Accuracy at long cycling horizons and generalization to unseen stack configurations remain unquantified in the abstract.
paper_title: HorizON: A Multi-Horizon Deep Operator Network for Property Prediction of Organic Battery Stacks
